process_name: Dispatch of goods Computer Hardware Shop

mappings.fragment_text: If goods shall be shipped, the secretary clarifies who will do the shipping
In these cases the secretary invites three logistic companies to make offers and she selects one of them
In case of small amounts, normal post shipment is used
a package label is written by the secretary and a parcel insurance taken by the logistics department head if necessary
In the meantime the goods can be already packaged by the warehousemen
If everything is ready, the packaged goods are prepared for being picked up by the logistic company

violations.constraint_description: [behavioral] The text mentions that the secretary clarifies who will do the shipping, but the BPMN model shows the secretary clarifying the shipment method.
violations.explanation: The text mentions that the secretary clarifies who will do the shipping, but the BPMN model shows the secretary clarifying the shipment method.

violations.constraint_description: [behavioral] The text implies that special shipping is a condition for inviting multiple logistic companies, but the BPMN model shows this path being taken regardless of special handling.
violations.explanation: The text implies that special shipping is a condition for inviting multiple logistic companies, but the BPMN model shows this path being taken regardless of special handling.

llm_raw_output.summary: There are several inconsistencies between the text description and the BPMN model, primarily concerning the assignment of tasks to roles (resource inconsistencies) and the sequence and conditions of certain steps (behavioral and structural inconsistencies). Specifically, the roles of the secretary and logistics department for writing package labels and insuring parcels are swapped. The timing and conditions for special shipping, normal post shipment, packaging, and preparation for pickup also differ between the text and the model.
